title: Tetris
tagline: Find your flow. Beat your best.
description: A fast, colorful solo stacker. Race through 40 Lines, chase points in two-minute Blitz, or settle into endless Zen with a saved board and undo. Tune your controls and handling, hold pieces, and plan ahead with a ghost and next-piece preview. Records and progress stay on this device.

controls.keyboard: Left/right: move. Down: soft drop. Up/X: clockwise. Z: counterclockwise. A: 180°. Space: hard drop. C/Shift: hold. Esc: pause. R: retry. Zen: Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo. Remap gameplay keys in Handling.
controls.touch: Use the on-screen movement, rotation, hold and drop buttons. Hold movement buttons to repeat.
controls.mouse: Choose a mode and use the on-screen controls. Open Handling to tune movement.
